brief: Holds a formula of named variables and gives its value and its exact derivatives at any point, by automatic differentiation.
detail: Build one with new stzMathFunction("x^2 + 3*x*y", [ "x", "y" ]). The engine compiles the formula once and walks it backwards to get the derivative with respect to every variable in one pass, exactly and not within a step size, which is what an optimiser or a check of a hand-derived gradient needs. The syntax is infix: + - * / ^ (right-associative), parentheses, exp, log, sqrt, sin, cos, tan, tanh, abs, min, max, pow, and the constants pi and e. A point is a list with one value per variable, in declared order. This is not the W() expression language of lists. Call Free when done with it.
